top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a complete discovery chain: proglucagon processing, identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, and its glucose-dependent insulinotropic and satiety actions were established as physiology, then validated by replicated efficacy and cardiovascular and renal outcome benefit in large randomized trials. The mechanism is mature after decades of independent confirmation. The allocation to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov with a citation anchored in physiology and peptide identity is defensible and within the three-laureate limit, so an award is preferable to no award.
